master.title: Azerbaijan Press Review - 14/02/2022
master.content:
AZERBAIJAN DAILY PRESS REVIEW

Subject: Main headlines in Azerbaijan on 14/02/2022

Political headlines

Coronavirus

Azerbaijan confirms 6,841 new COVID-19 cases. On 13 February, Azerbaijan detected 6,841 new COVID-19 cases, 6,722 persons recovered, and 23 persons died. To date, 745,169 persons have been infected with coronavirus in the country. Among those, 686,088 persons have recovered, and 9,050 persons have died. Currently, there are 50,031 active cases. Since the start of the vaccination, 12,478,257 vaccine doses have been administered in Azerbaijan (5,267,458 persons received the first dose, 4,764,254 persons the second dose and 2,446,545 persons the booster dose). (13/02/2022 Trend, more; more)

From tomorrow, requirements for the validity of COVID certificates change. From 15 February, the validity period of COVID certificates will be 6 months from the date of the second dose. The certificate will have an indefinite duration after the booster dose. (14/02/2022 APA, more)

Foreign Affairs

Law on ratification of the Shusha Declaration comes into force. On 12 February, President Aliyev signed the Law on the ratification of the Shusha Declaration on Allied Relations between Azerbaijan and Turkey, which was signed by the Azerbaijani and the Turkish Presidents on 15 June 2021. The Turkish Presidential Administration stressed that according to the declaration, Azerbaijan and Turkey will continue to make efforts to strengthen stability and security in the Caucasus region, restore economic and transport ties, as well as normalize the relations among the countries in the region and ensure long-term peace. (13/02/2022 Trend, more; more)

Azerbaijani deputy PM and Iranian minister discuss co-operation issues. Azerbaijani Deputy Prime Minister, Co-chairman of the Azerbaijan-Iran joint intergovernmental commission on economic cooperation Shahin Mustafayev held a virtual meeting with Iranian Minister of Road and Urban Development, Co-chairman of the commission from the Iranian side Rostam Ghasemi. The sides stressed the historical significance of the meeting between President Aliyev and President Raisi, held in Ashgabat on 28 November 2021 within the summit of the Economic Cooperation Organization. They emphasized the successful cooperation in the transit and transport sector, adding that the volume of cargo transportation via road between the two countries in 2021 increased by 70 percent. (13/02/2022 Trend, more)


Baku to host the 5th meeting of the Egypt-Azerbaijan Intergovernmental Commission. The fifth meeting of the Azerbaijan-Egypt Joint Intergovernmental Commission on Economic, Technical, and Scientific Cooperation will be held in Baku on 23-25 February, the Egyptian Embassy in Azerbaijan announced. According to the Egyptian Ambassador to Azerbaijan Adel Ibrahim, the Egypt-Azerbaijan Business Forum will also be held within the Commission's activity. The forum will be attended by nearly 30 representatives from companies operating in export, import, tourism, manufacturing, construction, agriculture, transport, communication, IT, financial sector, renewable energy, chemistry and heavy machinery industry. (12/02/2022 Report, more)

Azerbaijan, Iran and Turkmenistan are preparing a new gas agreement. Azerbaijan, Iran and Turkmenistan can expand cooperation on the issue of swap gas supplies, there are new proposals to increase the volume of supplies, said Azerbaijani Ambassador to Tehran Ali Alizadeh. 'The prospect of this project seems to be successful, there are even proposals to increase the volume of gas supplies, and negotiations in this direction are constantly being conducted by the relevant departments. There are new initiatives to strengthen bilateral and multilateral cooperation in the field of gas supplies, and they are currently being evaluated,' Alizadeh said. (12/02/2022 AzeriDaily, more)

Karabakh

Azerbaijani grid operator starts work to supply electricity to the Lachin Corridor. Azerbaijani electrical grid operator Azerishig OJSC has started work to supply electricity to the Lachin Corridor. The safety of the workers is protected by the Russian peacekeepers temporarily stationed in Azerbaijan. The supply work is carried out within the "Azerishig in Karabakh" project. (13.02.2022 Report, more)

AZAL introduces air navigation equipment at the Zangilan Airport. Another successful stage has been reached in the implementation of the project to restore air navigation services in the regained territories. The Azeraeronavigatsiya (AZANS) Air Traffic Control Administration under AZAL CJSC has announced the receipt of important international codes and frequencies for the air navigation radio systems of the Zangilan International Airport under construction. This was reported by the press service of AZAL. These codes and radio frequencies are necessary to provide air traffic control services, broadcast aviation meteorological information, commission communication systems, navigation, radar, etc. They ensure the integration of navigation equipment into the international system, and, accordingly, the safety and regularity of international flights. (11.02.2022 AzeriDaily, more)

Domestic News

Four officials of the Azerbaijani Defence Ministry were arrested. An operation was carried out in the Ministry of Defence and four officials were arrested. Colonel Rafael Khalilov, head of the financial menagement of the ministry, Bayram Bayramov, head of the financial department of the Ground Forces, Farahim Sarkarov, head of the financial department of the Nth military unit, and an officer of the ministry Vusal Alizade were detained. The accused were placed in pre-trial detention for four months. (13/02/2022 Trend, more)

President Aliyev visit the Aghdam and Aghjabadi districts. The Head of State and the First Lady attended the opening of AzerEnergy Open Joint Stock Company's 110/35/10 kV Aghdam-1 and Aghdam-2 electrical substations, and the Digital Management Center of the Karabakh Regional Electric Network. President Aliyev then laid the foundation for light poles powered by alternative and renewable energy sources, other facilities and carpet manufacturing enterprises, which will operate in the Aghdam Industrial Park, the Park Forest Hotel Aghdam and a 209-apartment new residential complex. They also viewed the ongoing restoration work at the Aghdam Juma Mosque being carried out by the Heydar Aliyev Foundation. President Aliyev inaugurated the newly renovated 110/35/10 kV "Aghjabadi" substation and attended the opening of the newly built military campus of the Internal Troops of the Ministry of Internal Affairs. (13/02/2022 Trend, more; more; more; more; more; more)


Economic News

Italy wants to increase gas imports through TAP to 10 billion cubic meters. Italy wants to increase its natural gas imports through the Trans Adriatic Pipeline (TAP) to 10 billion cubic meters per year, said the Secretary of State of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Italy Manlio Di Stefano. As the European section of the Southern Gas Corridor, TAP has the capacity to transport approximately 10 billion cubic meters of gas per annum (bcm/a) to several markets in Europe. The pipeline is also designed with the potential to expand its throughput capacity up to 20 bcm/a. (13/02/2022 Trend, more)


Development of Azerbaijan's dialogue with the Eurasian Economic Union would contribute to the intensification of trade. The development of Baku's dialogue with the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) in any format would contribute to the intensification of trade, development of transport and logistics infrastructure and, in general, would be useful to all states of the region, Director of the First Department of the CIS Countries of the Russian Foreign Ministry Mikhail Yevdokimov said. (13/02/22 Trend, more)
Finance Office of Turkey and Central Bank of Azerbaijan to sign a memorandum. The Finance Office of the Presidency of the Republic of Turkey and the Central Bank of Azerbaijan (CBA) are planning to sign a memorandum for more active coordination of measures on the digitalization in Azerbaijan and the development of high technology, Director General of the CBA Farid Osmanov said. "The advantages that the Agroexpress project gives over time may become attractive for the regional countries. After all, in the future, the project can also be used along the route of the North-South international transport corridor," the deputy minister said. (12/02/2022 Report, more)

Logistic barriers to be removed between Azerbaijan and Russia. The implementation of the Agroexpress project in Azerbaijan will create an opportunity for a more rational use of the transit and logistics potential of Azerbaijan and Russia and will strengthen transport and trade in the region, Deputy Minister of Economy Sahib Mammadov said in Xacmaz at the ceremony organised on the occasion of the departure of the first freight train as part of the Agroexpress project in Azerbaijan. (12/02/2022 Report, more)


Azerbaijan aims to create modern innovation space. The establishment of a modern innovation space is one of the priority areas in Azerbaijan, Deputy Minister of Digital Development and Transport Rovshan Rustamov said. According to him, this is reflected in the strategic document "Azerbaijan 2030: National Priorities for Socio-Economic Development", approved by Presidential order in February 2021. He noted that digital transformation is comprised of three parts. The first one is digital government, which provides better services and better governance through technologies. The second is the digital economy, which allows automating processes, creating digital products and making more accurate forecasts. And the final part of the digital transformation is the path to a society in which people have digital skills, entrepreneurs have access to open data, and value is created through innovation based on open data. (12/02/22 Trend, more; more)

Azerbaijan's hydrocarbon market is recovering. A recovery trend is observed in Azerbaijan in the hydrocarbon market, Deputy Head of the Market Research Department at the Russian Gazprombank Gulnara Khaidarshina said. Khaidarshina said that high inflows of export earnings contribute to the stability of the situation in the Azerbaijani foreign exchange market and the growth of the assets of the State Oil Fund of Azerbaijan (SOFAZ). "SOFAZ's assets grew by 3.4% and exceeded $45 billion in 2021," the deputy head of the department said. (13/02/22 Trend, more)


Social media

Social media users discuss the situation in Ukraine: The reports of the escalation of tension between Russia and Ukraine have been trending the social networks with users questioning if the war will spark indeed or not. Some users use the method of deduction to state that of all world powers, it is mainly the US that continues to foment anti-Russia sentiments. Some users believe that the US is interested in Russia's intervention in Ukraine, as the military scenario will give it good cards to play against Russia. According to other users, this is the biggest ever information war against Russia aimed at demonizing its image. With this, some users state, America aims to mobilize and rearm the NATO states located in the proximity of Russia. Some users call this the war of Anglo-Saxons against the Slavs with Ukraine used as a scapegoat and note that despite the outcome of the local confrontation, the Slavs are deemed to lose. Users state that the war may start even against the will of the two sides as third states may play an active role. Users also wrote about the financial sanctions, which may be introduced against Russia while commenting on reports about ruble crash. Despite all arguments and objective assessments, the great majority of users take an anti-Russian stand and express solidarity with Ukraine. Users vaunt over the "hard time" the West gives Russia and savour Russia's coming end. Many users take an anti-Russia position recalling Russia's invasive policy with regard to its neighbours, especially the Black January of 1990 in Baku and the "occupation of Karabakh". Some users express hope that the war will not break out and that the common sense will prevail over other instincts. Some users express sorrow over the possible losses of lives from both sides, calling the war an evil.

Please note that this press review includes information published by different sources and does not represent the views of the Delegation.
